claim.value: A retained subset is not necessarily unique.
claim.scope: Limit on uniqueness claims about reduction results.

provenance.rationale: P029 directly states the limitation; P028 identifies conditions that can produce different minimal subsets.

signal_basis.value: With test conditions fixed and a common repetition rule, a smaller configuration repeatedly reproduces lateness while specified further removals cease to reproduce it.
signal_basis.scope: Reduction tests for the selected late case under its replay conditions.

provenance.rationale: The cited spans identify the selected replay, fixed conditions, repetition rule and observed reduction pattern.
No unresolved empirical relation is needed to warrant this limitation.

rationale: Reproducing failure in one retained subset does not exclude other subsets that also reproduce it. Even exhaustive single-component removal checks establish only local minimality, not uniqueness. The claim appropriately leaves uniqueness open.
uncertainty: Whether this case actually has multiple sufficient subsets remains unknown; the claim does not assert that it does.
